plugins.name: permissions
plugins.description: Logs tool calls + sandbox denials + user prompts; provides /permissions-seed, /permissions-audit, /permissions-promote, /sandbox-fix, /permissions-lint, /permissions-bootstrap-project, and /permissions-advisor for tuning settings.json against real and anticipated usage and recovering from sandbox restrictions

plugins.name: find-docs
plugins.description: Retrieves up-to-date technical documentation, code examples, and performs people/company research using Context7 MCP and Exa AI MCP

plugins.name: session-timeline
plugins.description: Generates self-contained HTML timeline visualizations from Claude Code session transcripts — dark-themed, responsive, with stats, tool usage, subagent cards, and chronological event timeline

plugins.name: agent-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous coding loop for long-running tasks (refactors, new features, test sweeps). A bash harness re-invokes a fresh headless tick per task for OS-level context reset, handles blockers with a taxonomy, and builds dynamic sprint contracts per task. Requires the superpowers plugin; bundles postmortem and recommends the permissions plugin for its /permissions-advisor pre-flight check.

plugins.name: postmortem
plugins.description: Generic structured retrospective generator. Writes searchable postmortem documents to docs/postmortems/ with an 8-section template. Callable after any significant task.
